title: Review open-source licenses and software dependencies
summary: Before distributing software, changing deployment models or accepting dependencies with unresolved licensing. A reviewed dependency and license inventory with approved notices, obligations and exception decisions.
outcomes: A reviewed dependency and license inventory with approved notices, obligations and exception decisions.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before distributing software, changing deployment models or accepting dependencies with unresolved licensing.

parts.title: Inventory direct, transitive and bundled components
parts.guidance: Generate a component inventory for the actual build, including copied code, containers, assets and model or dataset components. Record versions, origin and the exact license text where available.

references.title: GitHub Open Source Guides: the legal side

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Describe how the components are used
parts.guidance: Distinguish internal use, hosted service, distribution, modifications and linking or packaging choices. Record missing or conflicting licenses and the build paths that include each component.

references.title: GitHub Open Source Guides: the legal side

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review obligations and compatibility
parts.guidance: Qualified counsel or the licensing reviewer evaluates the actual licenses and use model. Approve, replace or isolate components with unresolved rights rather than assuming a public repository grants reuse permission.

references.title: GitHub Open Source Guides: the legal side

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Prepare notices and the compliance package
parts.guidance: Assemble the approved attribution, license notices and any source or offer materials the reviewer requires. Ensure the package matches the released artifacts and keep customer-specific contractual promises separate.

references.title: GitHub Open Source Guides: the legal side

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve release and maintain the inventory
parts.guidance: The authorized reviewer confirms unresolved blockers are closed or explicitly accepted before release. Integrate dependency changes into review and retain the evidence used for the approved version.

references.title: GitHub Open Source Guides: the legal side

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting.
